component.name: Files
component.summary: File manager and graphical shell for the Cinnamon desktop

description.p: Nemo is the official file manager for the Cinnamon desktop. It allows you to browse directories, preview files and launch the applications associated with them, and it is also responsible for handling the icons on the desktop. It works on local and remote filesystems.
Nemo supports tabs, dual-pane ("Extra Pane") view, file previews, scripting through the context menu, and quick actions such as Duplicate and Backup of the selected items.
